description: This file defines the ServerLoop class interface and a component function for dependency injection in the Cuttlefish project. It sets up the server loop with required dependencies like configuration and controllers.

classes.name: ServerLoop
classes.description: An abstract base class representing the server loop, with a virtual destructor and a pure virtual Run method.

methods.name: ~ServerLoop
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the ServerLoop class.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Pure virtual method to run the server loop, returning a Result<void>.

methods.name: serverLoopComponent
methods.description: Function that returns a fruit::Component configuring dependencies for ServerLoop.
